  the repo's test file). The 2019 checkout cannot be built here (numpy 2.5.4 has no
  `numpy.distutils`; `setup.py build_ext --inplace` fails), so the harness loads the repo's
  `sklearn/mixture/{base,gaussian_mixture,bayesian_mixture}.py` over the installed sklearn
  1.9.1's support modules. Run from OUTSIDE the repo cwd (repo tree shadows `sklearn`):
  `cd /tmp && <venv python> aura_verify/repro_issue.py` → ALL OK post-fix; 7/13 mismatches pre-fix.

  `pytest aura_verify/test_gaussian_mixture_repo.py -q --assert=plain --confcutdir=<aura_verify dir> -p no:cacheprovider`
  (pytest 5.4.1.dev262 needs `--assert=plain` on py3.12; `--confcutdir` skips the repo's

  missing from alias` (pytest 5.4.1.dev262 assertion rewriting vs py3.12 AST).

  trivially; always assert the repo path is the one under test.

  upstream PR for #13142 and the sibling `scikit-learn-13142-nopanel` checkout's diff.
- Harness lives in `aura_verify/` inside the repo (write tools refuse paths outside the
  project folder); it is scratch and was removed after verification.

## Leads

- The 6 pre-existing test failures would likely pass with a fuller shim of old
  `sklearn.utils.testing` (exact NotFittedError message text) — left alone: out of scope.
